school: 实学（实理实学派·明遗民儒学东传传统）
historical_significance: 朱舜水（朱之瑜，1600-1682），明末清初学者、实学与水户学奠基宾师。明亡前屡辞征辟不仕；亡后奔走舟山、安南、日本乞师，参与郑成功长江之役，事败于 1659 年蹈海长留长崎，1665 年受德川光圀之聘为水户宾师——在日本定释奠礼、营学宫、造桥制器、课农授艺，把儒学做成可复制的制度与工程，深刻塑造了水户学与《大日本史》的'大义名分'史学，被水户藩尊为宗师。他终身明服不剃发、不仕清、不受日官，自题'明征君'——以一生示范了'实理实学''亡国不亡学'的政治伦理与文明传灯：学问的价值在能行、能验、能养民，文明的可存续不在疆土而在可移植的礼、学、艺与师承
historical_significance_en: Zhu Shunshui (Zhu Zhiyu, 1600-1682), scholar of the Ming-Qing transition and founding guest-master of practical learning and the Mito school. Before the fall he thrice declined summons to office; after it he ran the resistance circuit at Zhoushan, Annam and Japan, joined Zheng Chenggong's Yangtze expedition, and after its failure crossed the sea in 1659 to remain at Nagasaki — in 1665 engaged by Tokugawa Mitsukuni as guest-master of Mito, where he fixed the Confucian sacrifice, raised the academy, built bridges and vessels, taught agronomy and the crafts, making Confucianism into replicable institutions and works that deeply shaped the Mito school and the 'great-duty' historiography of the Dai Nihonshi, and was honoured by the domain as its fountainhead. He wore Ming dress for life, never shaved for the Qing, never served it, never took a Japanese office, and epitaphed himself 'Ming Zhengjun' — demonstrating in one life the political ethic and civilisational transmission of 'substantive learning' and 'the state falls, the learning does not': knowledge is worth what can be enacted, verified and made to nourish the people, and civilisation survives not in territory but in transplantable rites, learning, crafts and lineage
unique_thinking: 以'实'为纲的五层体系：认识论上以实理实学取代虚谈——知识必须可验、可行、可养民；变革论上以用处替代批判——旧学在更有效的替代品前自然退场；传播学上以异邦传灯选址（安、敬、空）与客卿之界（传学不干政、受礼不受官）保证文明的长期备份；政治伦理上以底线清单代替不可执行的誓言——不剃发、不易服、不仕清，身体即最后的文书；工程论上以实测、绘图、算料、小样把学问落到物上。其思维特质在于：把'儒者'从议士改造为匠师与工程师，把亡国的孤愤全部转化为建制、传习与记账式史学——诉状变账本，殉葬变传灯
unique_thinking_en: A five-layer system governed by the 'substantive': epistemologically, substantive learning replacing empty talk — knowledge must be verifiable, enactable, able to nourish; in change, usefulness displacing critique — old learning vacates before more effective substitutes; in transmission, the lamp-siting criteria (safety, reverence, vacancy) and the guest's boundary (teach without governing, honours without office) securing a long-term backup of civilisation; in political ethics, bottom-line lists replacing unexecutable vows — no shaving, no change of dress, no Qing service, the body as the final document; in engineering, measurement, drawing, material estimation and trial models landing learning in matter. His signature: remaking the Confucian from debater into craftsman and engineer, converting the grief of a fallen state entirely into institution-building, transmission and ledger-style historiography — indictments into ledgers, burial offerings into lamps
civilization_zh: 明清之际的士人现场与江户日本的宾师现场：1600 年生于浙江余姚世宦之家——万历、天启间亲见党争与辽事之坏；崇祯年间两征不就、弘光朝一年三却征辟——他早已不信任那个'讲学满朝、临事无人'的朝廷；乙酉（1645）之后奔走于舟山与日本之间乞师，两赴安南营救义师；己亥（1659）随郑成功入长江，败后五十九岁蹈海至长崎——'不肯剃发'的底线使留寓几乎成僵局，柳川儒医安东守约倾家供养，'守节'本身成了传灯的资历；1665 年德川光圀遣使聘为宾师，江户、水户两地礼敬：他定释奠仪注、绘学宫图说、指导造桥与祭器、课农授艺、教世子与重臣——水户学宫、湯島聖堂与《大日本史》的大义名分史学皆有他的方法血液；1682 年殁于江户，德川光圀谥文恭，葬瑞龙山，碑题'明征君朱之瑜墓'——一位把'亡国'活成'传灯'的老人：此身在，衣冠在，礼乐即在
civilization_en: The scholar's scene of the Ming-Qing transition and the guest-master's scene of Tokugawa Japan: born 1600 into a family of office in Yuyao, Zhejiang — he watched the factional strife and the Liaodong collapse under Wanli and Tianqi; twice summoned under Chongzhen and three times within a year under Hongguang he declined — he had long ceased to trust a court 'full of lecturers and empty of doers'; after 1645 he ran between Zhoushan and Japan seeking aid, and twice to Annam to rescue loyalist forces; in 1659 (jihaì) he followed Zheng Chenggong into the Yangtze, and after the defeat crossed the sea to Nagasaki at fifty-nine — his bottom line of 'never shaving' nearly stranded him at Nagasaki, until the Yanagawa physician-scholar Andō supported him at the ruin of his family: 'keeping integrity' itself became the credential of transmission; in 1665 Mitsukuni sent for him as guest-master, honoured at Edo and Mito alike: he fixed the Shidian rubrics, drew the academy plans, guided bridges and ritual vessels, taught agronomy and crafts, instructed the heir and the inner circle — the Mito academy, the Yushima Seidō and the great-duty historiography of the Dai Nihonshi all carry his methodic blood; he died at Edo in 1682, Mitsukuni gave the title 'Wengō', and he lies at Mount Zuiryū, the stele reading 'Tomb of Zhu Zhiyu, Zhengjun of Ming' — an old man who lived 'the fallen state' as 'the transmitted lamp': while this body remained, the dress remained, and where the dress remained, rites and music remained

modes.domain_zh: 认识论与实学方法论/以'实理'为知识的唯一判准：学问的价值不在言说之高妙而在应事接物之有效——凡不能落实到日用人伦、经世济民的'理'即是虚理；在明亡的废墟上，朱舜水把晚明空谈心性之弊反转为一条'实'的认识论纲领——知识必须可验证、可施行、可养民
modes.domain_en: Epistemological and pragmatic-learning methodology / taking 'substantive principle' (jitsuri) as the sole criterion of knowledge: the worth of learning lies not in the loftiness of discourse but in its efficacy in handling affairs — any 'principle' that cannot be cashed out in daily life, statecraft and the people's livelihood is an empty principle; on the ruins of the fallen Ming, Zhu Shunshui reversed the late-Ming malaise of empty talk about mind and nature into an epistemology of the 'substantive' — knowledge must be verifiable, executable and able to nourish the people
modes.definition_zh: 认识论与实学方法论/朱舜水身历明亡——他亲眼看见一个满朝讲学、语录满天下的帝国在务实与制度上的全面破产，故其学问的起点是对'虚'的清算：'学问之道，贵在实行'；'圣贤之学，不过日用常行'。他到日本后反复申说：儒者不是议场上的辩士而是工程现场的匠师——修史、制礼、造桥、开渠、课农、授艺，无一不是'实理'的试金石。方法论有三步：一、去虚——凡以玄谈、话头、语录相夸者皆斥为'虚学'；二、征实——每一命题必须问'行之何益、验之何据'；三、践实——学者必须亲手做成一件事才算学成。实理实学不是反智，而是把'知'的定义改写为'能行且有效'——这是三百多年后'实践是检验真理的标准'的先声此法的当代意义在于：它不否定理论，而是否定不可结算的理论——每一门学问都必须在成品处与账目处接受检验，否则即从知识降格为修辞。朱舜水在长崎与江户的每一次讲授都是此法的公开演练：学生问'太极是什么'，他答'太极即眼前之实'——把玄名落回日用；问'如何读史'，他答'读史如记账'——把叙述落回条目。实理实学因此不是一句口号，而是一套完整的知识审计流程：清算、征实、践实、结算，环环相扣。
modes.definition_en: Epistemological and pragmatic-learning methodology / Zhu Shunshui lived through the fall of the Ming — he watched an empire saturated with lecturing and quotation-collections collapse in precisely the practical and institutional dimensions it had neglected, and so his learning begins as an audit of the 'empty': 'the way of learning values actual practice'; 'the learning of the sages is nothing beyond daily use and ordinary conduct'. In Japan he insisted again and again that the Confucian scholar is not a debater in the hall but a craftsman at the site of works — compiling history, making ritual, building bridges, opening canals, teaching agriculture and the arts: each is the touchstone of 'substantive principle'. The method has three steps: first, sweep the empty — whatever trades on metaphysical talk, koans and quotation-mongering is condemned as 'empty learning'; second, verify the substantive — every proposition must answer 'what good when enacted, on what evidence tested'; third, enact it — a learner has not learned until he has built something with his own hands. Substantive learning is not anti-intellectual: it rewrites the definition of 'knowing' as 'being able to act, and acting effectively' — an ancestor, three centuries early, of the maxim that practice is the criterion of truth
modes.source_chapter: 《朱舜水集·答野节问》：'学问之道，贵在实行……圣贤之学，一日不可废者，实行也'；又《与小宅生顺书》论'实理实学'
modes.key_quote_zh: 学问如种树，说得满口春风不如亲手栽活一株——能应事的理才是实理，能养民的学才是实学；空谈心性者，明亡之时一个也救不了国。
modes.key_quote_en: Learning is like planting trees: a mouth full of spring wind is worth less than one sapling planted alive with your own hands — only a principle that handles affairs is substantive, only a learning that nourishes the people is real; the men who empty-talked mind and nature could not save the state when it fell.
key_concepts: 去虚三验 the triple test against emptiness（玄谈不可验、话头不可行、语录不可养民——三者居一即为虚学）
the triple test against emptiness (metaphysical talk cannot be verified, koans cannot be enacted, quotations cannot feed the people — any one marks empty learning)
征实之问 the verification question（每命题必答：行之何益、验之何据——不能回答者降格为假设）
the verification question (every proposition must answer: what good when enacted, on what evidence tested — what cannot answer is demoted to hypothesis)
践实成学 learning as enactment（学者以亲手做成一事为学成的唯一凭据——知与行的界线在成品处闭合）
learning as enactment (the sole credential of having learned is one thing made with one's own hands — the knowing-doing boundary closes at the finished work)
日用即本体 the ordinary as ground（圣贤之学不过日用常行——本体不在玄境而在耕织、礼乐、桥渠之间）
the ordinary as ground (the sages' learning is daily use and ordinary conduct — the ground of being lies not in mystic realms but in ploughing, weaving, rites and canals)
process_zh: 清算现有知识体系：把全部命题按'可验/不可验、可行/不可行'两轴分类——不可验不可行者明确标为虚学，弃之
对保留命题逐条做征实之问：行之何益、验之何据——把抽象命题改写为可操作的具体工序
以工程与实践为试金石：把命题投放进真实的营造、农政、礼制、教育现场——允许失败，但失败必须留下可归因的记录
以成品结算学问：学成的标志不是著述而是成品——一件建成的事、一套可行的礼、一门传授的手艺
process_en: Audit the existing body of knowledge: sort all propositions on two axes, verifiable/not and enactable/not — what is neither is explicitly marked empty learning and discarded
Put every retained proposition to the verification question: what good when enacted, on what evidence tested — rewriting abstract claims into concrete, operable procedures
Use works and practice as the touchstone: throw the proposition into real sites of building, agronomy, ritual and teaching — failure is permitted, but every failure must leave an attributable record
Settle learning at the finished work: the mark of having learned is not publication but the artefact — one thing built, one ritual that works, one craft successfully transmitted
representative_cases_zh: 晚明讲学之弊的切身诊断：朱舜水历数嘉隆以来'讲学家高谈性命，一旦临事，张皇失措'——满朝性理之学没能挡住清兵，也没能救活财政与河工；他把这场总崩溃读成'虚学误国'的总账，实理实学由此立论
在日本课农授艺：他向弟子与工匠传授农业、蚕桑、建筑、烹饪之术——例如教水户藩改良农田水利、把中国的园圃与酱食之艺带入日常——'学问'以增产与改良的成品兑现
答野节问学：学生问玄远之理，他答以'学问之道，贵在实行'，并要求对方先做一件实际的事再来问——把课堂从辩论场改为工场
representative_cases_en: A lived diagnosis of late-Ming lecturing: Zhu enumerated how, since the Jiajing-Longqing era, 'lecturers discoursed loftily on nature and destiny, yet at the first emergency stood bewildered' — a court full of principle-learning stopped neither the Qing armies nor the collapsing treasury and riverworks; he read the total collapse as the grand account of 'empty learning ruining the state', and on that account founded substantive learning

Teaching agriculture and the arts in Japan: he transmitted agronomy, sericulture, building and cookery to disciples and craftsmen — improving fields and irrigation in Mito, bringing Chinese gardening and fermented-food craft into daily life — 'learning' redeemed as harvests and improvements

Answering Nono Shigetoshi's questions: asked about remote metaphysics, he replied that 'the way of learning values actual practice' and required the student first to accomplish one real thing before asking — converting the classroom from debating floor to workshop
modern_applications_zh: 工程与技术组织的知识判准：立项答辩不问'理论是否高明'而问'可验之据、可行之序、可验之期'——凡三问不能答者不立项
教育与课程设计：以'亲手做成一件成品'为结课标准——报告与考试降格为过程记录，成品（可运行的系统、可用的器件、可复现的实验）才是学分
智库与政策研究：把'对策建议'一律改写为'可执行工序+验证指标'——防止玄学化的话语在生产与民生之外空转
modern_applications_en: A knowledge criterion for engineering organisations: project reviews ask not 'is the theory lofty' but 'what evidence verifies it, what sequence enacts it, by when it can be tested' — no answers, no project

Education and curriculum: the course closes when each learner has built one finished artefact — reports and exams demoted to process records; the work (a running system, a usable device, a reproducible experiment) carries the credit
Think tanks and policy research: rewrite every 'recommendation' as 'executable procedure plus verification metric' — preventing scholastic discourse from idling outside production and livelihood

modes.name_en: The Method of Transforming Customs through Rites
modes.domain_zh: 文化治理与礼制方法论/以礼为'化俗'的慢工程：不靠政令强制而靠把冠婚丧祭、释奠释菜做成可复制的仪式件，让异邦之俗在数十年间自内而外地改变——礼不是装饰而是社会操作的接口，一套做得到的仪轨胜过十道变不了心的禁令
modes.domain_en: Cultural-governance and ritual methodology / ritual as a slow engineering of customs: not compulsion by decree, but transforming a foreign land's manners from within over decades by making capping, marriage, mourning, sacrifice and the Confucian ceremony into replicable ritual components — rite is not ornament but the interface of social operation; one workable liturgy outweighs ten prohibitions that never reach the heart
modes.definition_zh: 文化治理与礼制方法论/朱舜水在日本不以传教者姿态抨击日俗，而以'做给你看'的方式化俗：他为水户藩设计学宫、绘制释奠礼的冠服祭器图式、亲手教习仪式流程——把《仪礼》《礼记》中的礼从文本还原为可执行的'仪式件'。方法论要点：一、接口先行——先做一件本地人可见、可学、可仿的礼（学宫祭孔），而非先立教条；二、降维传习——把复杂礼典拆为图纸、器物、步法三件套，使凡人可复制；三、以美化俗——礼的吸引力来自其庄重与美（正衣冠、肃仪节、雅乐容），让人'欲罢不能'而非'被迫服从'；四、慢周期预期——化俗以三十年计，不争一朝一夕。这套方法使日本有了成规模的儒礼实践，水户学由此有制度躯体此法的当代意义在于：文化转型不是说服工程而是接口工程——先造出一件对方看得见、学得会、用得上的仪式件，其余交给时间与模仿。此法的当代意义在于：一切观测系统先从观测者自己校准起——自我摘除利害与情面，当面回路传递异议，小节零弯曲保大判断零偏差。此法的当代意义在于：变革的胜负手不在论战而在替代品的可见质量——把资源改道给能赢的场景，旧秩序在失血中安静退场。此法的当代意义在于：知识只有经过图纸、算料与小样的完整工序才算真正掌握——图纸即承诺，样品即检验，规程即传承。
modes.definition_en: Cultural-governance and ritual methodology / in Japan Zhu never attacked native custom as a missionary would; he transformed custom by 'doing it before your eyes': he designed the Mito academy, drew the diagrams of robes and vessels for the Shidian (Confucian sacrifice), personally drilled the sequence of the ceremony — reducing the rites of the Yili and Liji from text to executable 'ritual components'. The method's points: first, interface first — make one rite the locals can see, learn and imitate (the Confucian sacrifice at the academy) before promulgating any doctrine; second, dimension-reduced transmission — split a complex liturgy into drawings, objects and step-charts so that ordinary men can replicate it; third, transform by beauty — the rite attracts through its gravity and beauty (correct dress, solemn steps, elegant music), making people 'unable to refrain' rather than 'forced to comply'; fourth, slow-cycle expectation — transforming customs is reckoned in thirty years, never in a day. By this method Japan gained a full-scale practice of Confucian ritual, and Mito learning gained its institutional body
modes.source_chapter: 《朱舜水集·学宫图说》与释奠仪注诸篇；德川光圀延请朱舜水行释奠礼、定湯島聖堂释奠之制
modes.key_quote_zh: 化俗不在令而在礼——禁十道不如行一礼；把礼做成图纸与器物，让任何人都照着做得出来，三代之俗便可移于海外。
modes.key_quote_en: Customs are transformed not by decree but by rite — ten prohibitions yield to one performed ceremony; make ritual into drawings and vessels that anyone can copy, and the manners of the Three Dynasties may be transplanted overseas.
key_concepts: 接口先行 interface first（先立一件可见可仿之礼以开接口，教条后行）
interface first (establish one visible, imitable rite as the opening interface; doctrine follows)
仪式三件套 the ritual triad（图纸+器物+步法——把礼拆到凡人可复制的颗粒度）
the ritual triad (drawings plus vessels plus step-charts — ritual parsed to a granularity any ordinary person can replicate)
以美化俗 transformation by beauty（礼之庄重与美自身即传播力——吸引力替代强制）
transformation by beauty (the rite's gravity and beauty are themselves the transmission force — attraction replacing compulsion)
慢周期化俗 the slow-cycle horizon（以三十年为期规划风俗变迁——拒绝一次性运动式改造）
the slow-cycle horizon (plan the change of customs on a thirty-year horizon — refusing one-shot campaign-style transformation)
process_zh: 勘察当地礼俗：列出现有冠婚丧祭的形制与人心向背——找出'可嫁接点'而非全盘否定
选定制高点仪式：选一件最能展示文明深度的礼（祭孔释奠）做成完整可复制件——图纸、器物、仪注齐备
亲身示范与传习：以宾师身份亲自主持数届，训练本地司仪与工匠——使仪式不再依赖外人
放手观察与迭代：退居顾问，让本地人自主行礼——按其误与变修订图式，俗成而后功成
process_en: Survey local rites: chart the existing forms of capping, marriage, mourning and sacrifice and where hearts incline — seeking grafting points, not wholesale negation
Choose the summit rite: pick the one ceremony that best displays civilisational depth (the Confucian Shidian) and make it a complete replicable set — drawings, vessels and rubrics all supplied
Demonstrate and drill in person: preside over several cycles as guest-master, training local officiants and craftsmen until the rite no longer depends on the outsider
Withdraw, observe and iterate: step back to adviser, let locals perform on their own — revise the diagrams according to their errors and variations; the custom ripens, then the work is done
representative_cases_zh: 水户学宫与释奠：朱舜水为德川光圀绘学宫图、定释奠仪注、造祭器模型——1663 年水户行释奠礼，日本第一次按宋明仪注行孔祭；此后湯島聖堂释奠亦源其范式
冠服与容礼的示范：他坚持明式衣冠，同时把揖让进退的容节教给日本弟子——安積覚等人的行止风仪使'儒者气象'成为可见物
饮食、园圃与日用之礼：他把中华的酱食、馔法与园圃布置带入日常——以'日用之美'在最琐碎处化俗
representative_cases_en: The Mito academy and the Shidian: Zhu drew the academy plans, fixed the Shidian rubrics and modelled the vessels for Tokugawa Mitsukuni — in 1663 Mito performed the Confucian sacrifice, the first in Japan following Song-Ming rubrics; the later Yushima Seidō rites descend from this paradigm

Demonstration of dress and deportment: he kept Ming dress to the end while teaching the courtesies of bow and pace to Japanese disciples — the bearing of Asaka Tanpaku and others made the 'air of a Confucian' a visible object

The rites of food, garden and daily use: he brought Chinese fermented foods, cuisine and garden arrangement into daily life — transforming custom at its most trivial points through the beauty of the ordinary
modern_applications_zh: 组织文化落地：文化转型不靠发文宣讲而靠设计一两件'可见可仿的仪式件'（评审会、复盘式、入职礼）——让新文化有接口与样板
产品与设计出海：进入新市场先做'接口先行'的示范样板（旗舰案例、公开标准），以降维传习（文档+模板+步法）让本地团队可复制
公共政策设计：移风易俗类政策以'样板仪式+三十年周期'评估——拒绝运动式一刀切
modern_applications_en: Landing organisational culture: transform not by memos and speeches but by designing one or two 'visible, imitable ritual components' (the review meeting, the retrospective format, the onboarding rite) — giving the new culture interfaces and exemplars

Products and design going abroad: enter a new market with an interface-first demonstrator (flagship case, open standard), then dimension-reduced transmission (docs plus templates plus step-charts) so local teams can replicate
Public policy: evaluate habit-change policies by 'exemplar rite plus thirty-year horizon' — refusing campaign-style one-size-fits-all
representative_figures: 朱舜水（核心）
孔子（源头参照：'移风易俗，莫善于乐；安上治民，莫善于礼'——朱舜水把此语做成海外工程）
德川光圀（协同参照：以藩主权柄供养礼制工程——宾主合力使化俗有政治庇护）

modes.name_en: The Method of Transmitting the Lamp in a Foreign Land
modes.domain_zh: 文明传播与流亡方法论/国土可失而文脉不可断：当故国不可归，把文明的火种托付给最能护火的异邦——不求其地而求其器，不求其名而求其传；以客卿之身在异邦建制传学，使亡国者的孤愤转化为另一种形式的'存续'——亡国不亡学
modes.domain_en: Civilisational-transmission and exile methodology / the territory may be lost but the lineage must not break: when the homeland is beyond return, entrust the ember of civilisation to the foreign ground best able to shelter fire — seek not the land but the vessel, not the name but the transmission; as a guest minister in a foreign country, build institutions and teach, converting a fallen subject's grief into another form of survival — the state perishes, the learning does not
modes.definition_zh: 文明传播与流亡方法论/朱舜水1659年蹈海至长崎时已五十九岁，复国无望——他面对的选择是：抱故国之器老死，或择地传灯。他选后者，并给出了传灯的选地标准：一、安——政治稳定能护学数十年（江户日本两百年太平）；二、敬——主政者真心向学而非利用符号（德川光圀执弟子礼）；三、空——其地所学有真实缺口可填（日本儒学缺礼制与实行传统）。方法论的核心是把'流亡'从被动状态改写为主动的文明选址：不与故国作无谓的殉葬，而以异邦为文明的备份介质；同时坚守'客卿之界'——传学而不干政，受礼而不受官，使传灯可持续此法的当代意义在于：流亡与迁移不只是逃难——按安、敬、空三准主动选址，把不可挽回的损失转化为文明与知识的异地备份。此法的当代意义在于：影响力可以不用职权购买——以独立身份、退出自由与持续展示的德学换取说'不'的席位，是咨询与治理的结构设计。此法的当代意义在于：在被迫同化的环境里，选最小、可日常执行、与真知识绑定的符号坚持下去——符号不空壳，统绪即可接续。
modes.definition_en: Civilisational-transmission and exile methodology / when Zhu crossed the sea to Nagasaki in 1659 he was fifty-nine, restoration beyond hope — his choice was to die with the vessels of the fallen state or to choose ground and transmit the lamp. He chose transmission, and laid down siting criteria for the lamp: first, safety — a stable polity able to shelter learning for decades (two centuries of Tokugawa peace); second, reverence — a ruler who honours learning itself, not its symbolism (Mitsukuni performing the disciple's rites); third, vacancy — a real gap in the host's learning that he alone can fill (Japanese Confucianism lacked traditions of ritual and practice). The method's core rewrites 'exile' from a passive condition into an active siting of civilisation: no futile burial with the fallen state, but the foreign land as a backup medium of civilisation; meanwhile he kept the 'guest's boundary' — teach without governing, accept honours without office — so the transmission could last
modes.source_chapter: 《朱舜水集·安积觉批注》与本传诸篇；1659 长崎留寓、1665 应德川光圀之聘赴江户（水户宾师）始末
modes.key_quote_zh: 国亡了，衣冠礼乐不能跟着一起沉海——此地能安、其主能敬、其学有缺，便在此传灯；我不做故国的殉葬品，我做文明的备份。
modes.key_quote_en: The state has fallen; let not dress, rites and music sink with it — where the ground is safe, the lord reverent, the learning vacant, there I transmit the lamp; I will not be my country's burial offering, I am civilisation's backup.
key_concepts: 传灯选址三准 the three siting criteria（安、敬、空——政治能护、主者能敬、所学有缺，缺一不传）
the three siting criteria (safety, reverence, vacancy — the polity must shelter, the lord must honour, the learning must be wanted; lacking one, do not transmit)
客卿之界 the guest's boundary（传学不干政、受礼不受官——保持传灯者的中立性以获长期庇护）
the guest's boundary (teach without governing, accept honours without office — the transmitter's neutrality purchases long-term shelter)
文明备份 the civilisational backup（把师承、礼制、技艺打包为可移植的整体——不在一棵树上备份）
the civilisational backup (pack lineage, ritual and craft as one transplantable whole — never back up on a single tree)
孤愤转化 grief converted（把亡国之痛转化为传学的 endurance——悲愤不耗于哀毁而耗于建成）
grief converted (turn the pain of a fallen state into the endurance of teaching — sorrow spent not in lament but in building)
process_zh: 承认不可逆：正式宣告复国无望——把'等待'从人生预算中删除，避免流亡者最常见的虚耗
按三准选址：对潜在庇护地逐一评估安、敬、空——宁缓不滥，标准不满足则继续观察
议定客卿之界：与主政者约定名分（宾师而非家臣）、边界（不预政事）与传习义务（建制、课徒、制器）
整装打包传习：把毕生所学整理为可传授的体系（礼、学、艺、史）——用余生完成从'故国遗民'到'异邦传灯者'的身份重写
process_en: Acknowledge irreversibility: declare formally that restoration is beyond hope — delete 'waiting' from the budget of life, avoiding the commonest waste of the exile
Site by the three criteria: assess safety, reverence and vacancy for each potential refuge — rather slow than promiscuous; if the standard is unmet, keep watching
Fix the guest's boundary: settle with the ruler the status (guest-master, not retainer), the limits (no politics) and the duties of transmission (institutions, students, instruments)

Pack the whole learning for transmission: organise a lifetime's knowledge into a teachable system (rites, learning, crafts, history) — spending the remaining years rewriting identity from 'remnant of a fallen state' to 'transmitter of the lamp in a foreign land'
representative_cases_zh: 长崎岁月的坚守与入选：1659 年抵长崎后一度因'不归化不得留'陷入绝境，他以'不肯剃发改服'的底线与坚持赢得柳川藩儒安东守约倾家供养——'守节'本身成为被选择理由的一部分；1665 年德川光圀聘为宾师，三准全部满足
水户宾师的建制：他在水户定释奠、营学宫、课弟子——把儒学的礼制骨架整体移植，而非零卖几句经义
至死不仕清、不受日官：他终身着明服、辞谢日本官位——客卿之界使德川家两代对他礼敬不衰，传灯因节制而长久
representative_cases_en: Nagasaki: endurance and selection: arriving in 1659 he nearly fell at the rule that non-naturalised men must leave; his bottom line — refusing to shave the head or change dress — and his steadfastness won the scholar Andō Shōeki's? (Andō Seian of Yanagawa) family-ruining support — 'keeping integrity' itself became part of why he was chosen; in 1665 Mitsukuni engaged him as guest-master and all three criteria were met
Building at Mito: he fixed the rites, raised the academy, drilled the disciples — transplanting the skeletal frame of Confucian ritual as a whole, not selling off a few classical phrases

Never serving the Qing, never taking a Japanese office: he wore Ming dress for life and declined Japanese rank — the guest's boundary kept the Tokugawa honouring him across two generations; the lamp lasted because he was temperate
modern_applications_zh: 人才与团队的跨国迁移：核心知识持有者选择新东家时按'安（组织稳定）、敬（真心尊重专业）、空（真实缺口）'三准评估——避免为高薪跳入不护火的组织
开源社区与知识备份：把关键知识体系打包为可移植工件（文档、标准、工具链）并在多个'护火者'之间冗余存放——单点依赖即断代风险
危机中的领导层选择：失败组织的核心成员以'传灯'而非'殉葬'规划退出——把延续使命作为比名义体面更高的目标
modern_applications_en: Cross-border moves of talent and teams: a holder of core knowledge evaluates a new host by safety (organisational stability), reverence (genuine respect for the craft) and vacancy (a real gap) — never jumping for salary into an organisation that will not shelter fire

Open-source and knowledge backup: package the key knowledge system as portable artefacts (docs, standards, toolchains) and keep redundant copies among several fire-keepers — single-point dependence is the risk of a broken lineage
Leadership choices in collapse: core members of a failing organisation plan their exit as transmission, not burial — making the survival of the mission a higher goal than nominal decency
representative_figures: 朱舜水（核心）
鉴真（先例参照：同为东渡传灯者——鉴真传佛法与律制，朱舜水传儒礼与实学，六次东渡与一次蹈海互为镜像）
马礼逊/早期来华传教士（反向平行：异邦人来华建制传学——同样依'安、敬、空'选址，说明传灯法则与文明方向无关）

modes.name_en: The Method of Lone Loyalty across the Sea
modes.domain_zh: 政治伦理与气节方法论/忠不是对君主个人的依附而是对'所自出之文明'的终身契约：国亡之后，忠的对象从朝廷转换为衣冠、礼乐与故国之名——以可执行的底线（不剃发、不改服、不仕新朝、不受异邦之官）代替不可执行的誓言（复国）；孤忠的价值不在成败而在为一种政治伦理留下活的样本
modes.domain_en: Political-ethics and integrity methodology / loyalty is not personal fealty to a monarch but a lifelong covenant with the civilisation one issues from: after the state falls, the object of loyalty shifts from court to dress, rites and the name of the homeland — executable bottom lines (never shave the head, never change dress, never serve the new dynasty, never take a foreign office) replacing unexecutable vows (restoration); the worth of lone loyalty lies not in success but in leaving a living specimen of a political ethic
modes.definition_zh: 政治伦理与气节方法论/朱舜水的忠是经过重新定义的：他早岁三辞征辟（崇祯、弘光两朝屡召不就），不是不忠而是把忠从'做官'中剥离；明亡后他奔走舟山、日本乞师，参与郑成功 1658-59 北伐长江之役——事败后蹈海长留日本。此后二十年他的忠只表现为一组可执行底线：不剃发（拒绝清的身体符号征服）、不易服（保存故国衣冠）、不仕清、不受日本官职、死不归葬（自题墓曰'明征君'）。方法论要点：一、把忠翻译为底线清单——底线可执行、可核验，誓言不可；二、以身体为最后的文书——衣冠与发肤即政治声明；三、孤而不绝——忠不要求同侪，但要求传承（弟子与著述仍在）；四、拒绝殉死的道德绑架——活着的坚守比一死更难也更有效此法的当代意义在于：把不可执行的忠诚誓言翻译为可执行、可核验、愿付代价的底线清单——底线存则立场存，且比任何宣言更难被伪造。这条底线清单的每一次执行都有真实代价：在长崎，不剃发几乎使他被遣返；在日本二十年，不易服使他始终是'外人'；不受官使他没有固定俸禄。但正是这些可核验的代价使他的立场无可怀疑——旁观者可以怀疑任何誓言，却无法怀疑一个日复一日付出代价的身体。
modes.definition_en: Political-ethics and integrity methodology / Zhu's loyalty was redefined: in his early years he declined summons to office three times (under Chongzhen and Hongguang) — not from disloyalty but by detaching loyalty from office-holding; after the fall he ran the resistance circuit at Zhoushan and sought aid in Japan, joining Zheng Chenggong's 1658-59 Yangtze expedition — and after its failure crossed the sea to remain in Japan. For twenty years his loyalty consisted of a set of executable bottom lines: never shave the head (refusing the Qing's conquest of the body as symbol), never change dress (preserving the homeland's attire), never serve the Qing, never take a Japanese office, never return for burial (self-epitaph: 'Ming Zhengjun'). The method: first, translate loyalty into a bottom-line list — bottom lines are executable and checkable; vows are not; second, the body as final document — dress and hair are the political statement; third, alone yet unbroken — loyalty requires no companions but does require transmission (disciples and writings persist); fourth, refuse the moral coercion of martyrdom — a living stand is harder, and more effective, than one clean death
modes.source_chapter: 《朱舜水集》自述与书札；三辞征辟、舟山乞师、辛丑长江之役（1659）后留居日本、自题墓碑'明征君朱之瑜墓'诸事
modes.key_quote_zh: 复国我做不到，剃发我也做不到——把做不到的誓言换成做得到的底线：不剃、不易、不仕、不受；此身衣冠尚在，故国便没有全亡。
modes.key_quote_en: Restoration I cannot do; shaving the head I also cannot do — exchange the unexecutable vow for executable bottom lines: no shaving, no changing dress, no service, no office; while this body still wears the homeland's dress, the homeland is not wholly lost.
key_concepts: 底线清单化 loyalty as bottom lines（把不可核验的誓言改写为一组可执行、可核验的拒绝）
loyalty as bottom lines (rewrite unverifiable vows into a set of executable, checkable refusals)
身体即文书 the body as document（衣冠发肤是最不可伪造的政治声明——用身体签署立场）
the body as document (dress and hair are the least forgeable political statement — sign one's position with the body)
孤而不绝 alone yet unbroken（忠的存续系于传承而非从众——弟子、著述、礼制即忠的载体）
alone yet unbroken (loyalty endures through transmission, not company — disciples, writings and rites are its carriers)
反殉道绑架 anti-martyrdom coercion（活着的坚守是更贵也更有效的忠——拒绝以死卸责）
anti-martyrdom coercion (a living stand is the costlier and more effective loyalty — refuse to discharge duty by dying)
process_zh: 重定义忠的对象：把忠从君主个人改写为文明本体（衣冠、礼乐、故国之名）——使忠在朝廷消失后仍有落点
列底线清单：把立场翻译为少数几条可执行、可核验、不可妥协的拒绝——每条都必须付出真实代价
以身体执行：衣冠、发肤、葬地、题铭——让立场在最小处也不可撤销
配套传承：底线之忠必须与传灯配套（课徒、著述、建制）——使孤忠不是姿态而是文明存续的工程之一部分
process_en: Redefine the object of loyalty: from the monarch to civilisation itself (dress, rites, the name of the homeland) — so loyalty retains a landing place after the court is gone
Draw up the bottom-line list: translate the position into a few executable, checkable, non-negotiable refusals — each costing something real
Execute with the body: dress, hair, burial ground, epitaph — make the position irreversible down to the smallest point
Pair with transmission: bottom-line loyalty must be paired with the lamp (teaching, writing, institution-building) — so lone loyalty is not a pose but a component of civilisational survival
representative_cases_zh: 三辞征辟的'忠'之预习：崇祯年间两征不就、弘光朝一年内三次拒绝征召——他早已把'入仕'与'忠'解绑，故国难来临时他的立场清单早已写好
长江之役与乞师：年近六旬仍亲赴安南、日本乞师，参与郑成功北伐——忠不是清谈而是奔走；事败后他不殉死而蹈海，把忠从一掷改写为长跑
留日二十年的四不：不剃发、不易服、不仕清、不受日官；殁后德川光圀谥'文恭'、葬瑞龙山，墓依明制——身体的文书由墓碑归档
representative_cases_en: Three refusals as loyalty's rehearsal: twice summoned under Chongzhen and three times refusing within a year under Hongguang — he had long since unbound office from loyalty, so when the catastrophe came his position list was already written

The Yangtze campaign and the hunt for aid: near sixty he sailed himself to Annam and Japan seeking troops and joined Zheng Chenggong's northern expedition — loyalty as errand, not talk; after the defeat he did not die but crossed the sea, rewriting loyalty from one throw into a long run

Twenty years of the four refusals: no shaving, no change of dress, no Qing service, no Japanese office; at his death Mitsukuni gave the posthumous title 'Wengō' and burial at Mount Zuiryū in Ming style — the body's document archived by the gravestone
modern_applications_zh: 职业伦理的底线管理：把'忠于职业'翻译为少数可核验的拒绝清单（不做假数据、不背签、不泄密）——清单比口号更能穿越组织更迭
流亡与离散组织的存续：失败组织的成员以'底线+传承'维持认同——不要求人人殉道，但要求把核心知识与方法带出去并教下去
个人品牌与信用的建立：长期信用来自一小组一贯付出的拒绝——可核验的'不做'比可宣称的'愿做'更贵
modern_applications_en: Bottom-line management of professional ethics: translate 'loyalty to the craft' into a few checkable refusals (no fabricated data, no blind sign-offs, no leaks) — a list survives organisational turnover better than a slogan

Survival of exiled and diasporic organisations: members of a failed organisation keep identity by 'bottom lines plus transmission' — no martyrdom demanded, but the core knowledge and method must be carried out and taught on
Building personal credit: long-run credit comes from a small set of refusals consistently paid for — checkable 'will-nots' cost more than professed 'wills'
representative_figures: 朱舜水（核心）
伯夷叔齐（先例参照：不食周粟的底线型忠——朱舜水以'底线+传灯'把这一传统现代化）
文天祥（对照参照：以死明志的正气歌传统——朱舜水选择'不死的坚守'，两种忠的代价函数不同）

modes.domain_zh: 伦理学与知行方法论/以'直躬'（身正行直）为致知的前提：认识的失真多源于立场的弯折——利害、恩怨、体面使人对事实视而不见；先把自己放直（不因利而曲、不因惧而讳、不因情而饰），知识才有一个可信的观测点；直不是刚愎，而是把'我'从结论中摘出去
modes.domain_en: Ethical and knowing-acting methodology / 'straight-bodiedness' as the precondition of knowing: most distortion of knowledge comes from the bending of standpoint — interest, grudges and face make one blind to facts; straighten yourself first (never bend for gain, never conceal from fear, never varnish from sentiment) and knowledge gains a trustworthy observation point; straightness is not obstinacy but extracting 'I' from the conclusion
modes.definition_zh: 伦理学与知行方法论/朱舜水一生以'直'著称：他当面纠正德川光圀的失礼与过失，对日本权贵不谄、对故国遗老不隐——其认识论的一半是伦理学的：一个人若在利害前弯折，他的一切观测都不可信。方法论要点：一、身正为仪器校准——把自身的利害、恩怨、体面视为测量误差源，先做'自我摘除'；二、当面不背后——纠错当面直言，不搞背后议论，使信息回路最短；三、直而有礼——直不等于伤人，以礼包装直言使其可被接受；四、小节即大节——日常一处弯曲（受一礼、讳一事）即为整个观测系统埋下系统性偏差。此法与其'实理实学'互为表里：实学求真，直躬保真此法的当代意义在于：一切观测系统先从观测者自己校准起——自我摘除利害与情面，当面回路传递异议，小节零弯曲保大判断零偏差。他直纠德川光圀时不因对方是权倾一方的藩主而降调，也不因安东守约倾家供养而讳言其短——受恩不曲是此法最难的检验：恩义最容易成为弯折的理由，而直躬要求连恩义也不能弯曲观测点；直者先直于施恩于己之人，才算真的直。
modes.definition_en: Ethical and knowing-acting methodology / 'straight-bodiedness' as the precondition of knowing: Zhu was known all his life for straightness — correcting Tokugawa Mitsukuni's lapses to his face, flattering no magnate in Japan, concealing nothing from the elders of the fallen dynasty; half his epistemology is ethics: a man who bends before interest makes every observation untrustworthy. The method: first, uprightness as instrument calibration — treat one's own interests, grudges and face as sources of measurement error and perform 'self-extraction' first; second, face-to-face, never behind — correct to the face, no back-channel commentary, keeping the information loop shortest; third, straight yet courteous — straightness is not wounding; wrap frankness in ritual so it can be received; fourth, small bends are great bends — one daily crookedness (one accepted favour, one concealed fact) seeds systematic bias through the whole observing system. The method is the twin of substantive learning: the learning seeks truth, the straight body keeps it true
modes.source_chapter: 《朱舜水集·答问》诸篇论'躬行'与'直'；《安积覚笔录》载其直纠光圀与'不妄语'之教
modes.key_quote_zh: 尺子本身弯了，量什么都是错的——先把自己放直：利不动、惧不讳、情不饰；直不是嗓门大，是把'我'从结论里摘出去。
modes.key_quote_en: When the ruler itself is bent, everything it measures is wrong — straighten yourself first: unmoved by gain, silent on nothing from fear, varnishing nothing from sentiment; straightness is not a loud voice, it is extracting 'I' from the conclusion.
key_concepts: 自我摘除 self-extraction（把自身利害与情面作为误差源先行摘除——观测前的仪器校准）
self-extraction (one's own interests and faces removed first as error sources — calibration before observation)
当面回路 the face-to-face loop（纠错与异议走最短信息回路——背后议论是失真的温床）
the face-to-face loop (corrections and dissent travel the shortest information path — back-channel talk breeds distortion)
直而以礼 straightness wrapped in rite（直言以礼为包装——使其可听、可受、可持续）
straightness wrapped in rite (frankness packaged in courtesy — audible, receivable, sustainable)
小节偏差 small-bend bias（日常微弯曲累积为系统性认知偏差——节操是认识论工程）
small-bend bias (daily micro-bends compound into systematic cognitive bias — integrity is an epistemological engineering)
process_zh: 校准自检：任何判断前先列自身的利害关系与情面顾虑——把'我'的位置明示出来
当面直言：异议与纠错当面陈述，配以礼的形式（称其是而后指其非）——不采用背后渠道
持续直行：把直做成日常习惯（小诺必践、小讳必无）——以小节的零弯曲维护大判断的零偏差
接受反直检验：允许他人以同样的直回敬自己——把直从个人品格升级为共同规范
process_en: Calibration self-check: before any judgement, list one's own interests and face-concerns — make the position of 'I' explicit
Speak to the face: state dissent and corrections in person, in ritual form (acknowledge what is right before naming what is not) — never through back channels
Practise straightness continuously: make it a daily habit (small promises kept, small concealments absent) — zero small-bend variance guards the zero-bias of large judgements
Accept the counter-test of straightness: allow others the same straightness toward oneself — upgrading it from private virtue to shared norm
representative_cases_zh: 直纠德川光圀：光圀行事有失，朱舜水当 container 面规谏、不稍假借——宾师之'宾'正因他保持了对主君说'不'的独立性，光圀反而愈加敬重
对安东守约的'不妄语'之教：守约倾家养他，他却坚持不受非分之奉、不言不由衷之谢——受恩不曲，恩义不成为弯折的理由
论史直书：他评点历代兴亡不以胜败谀之、不以亲疏讳之——评价体系自它的观测者开始就要直
representative_cases_en: Straight correction of Mitsukuni: when the lord erred Zhu remonstrated to his face, conceding nothing — the 'guest' in guest-master meant precisely the independence to say no to one's host, and Mitsukuni honoured him the more for it

The lesson of 'no false speech' to Andō: though Andō ruined his family to support him, Zhu refused improper offerings and perfunctory thanks — favours received must not bend him; gratitude is no licence to curve
Frank judgment of history: he judged the rises and falls of dynasties neither flattering the victor nor screening the favoured — an evaluation system must begin straight at its observer
modern_applications_zh: 审计与尽调的职业化：审计师的'独立性'落地为自检表（我与被审方有何利害）+当面沟通规范——把伦理写成观测规程
组织反馈文化：建立'当面直言+礼式表达'的规范（先认其是、再指其非）——消灭背后议论这一最大失真源
AI与数据系统治理：把'利益冲突申报'视为仪器校准——未被申报的弯曲会污染整个下游判断
modern_applications_en: Professionalising audit and due diligence: independence lands as a self-check sheet (what interests do I hold in the audited) plus a face-to-face norm — ethics written as observation protocol
Feedback culture in organisations: a norm of 'speak to the face, in courteous form' (affirm what is right, then name what is not) — eliminating back-channel talk, the greatest distortion source
Governance of AI and data systems: treat conflict-of-interest declaration as instrument calibration — an undeclared bend pollutes every downstream judgement
representative_figures: 朱舜水（核心）
子路（先例参照：'勿欺也，而犯之'——对君主当面而犯的直的传统）
魏征（平行参照：以直谏为职业的诤臣——魏征在体制内直，朱舜水以宾师之身在体制外直，两种直的杠杆不同）

modes.name_en: The Method of Emptiness Displaced by Use
modes.domain_zh: 组织变革与思想斗争方法论/不以'批判'消灭虚学而以'用处'替代虚学：旧观念不能被论战杀死，只能在更有效的替代品面前枯萎——为新学找足够多、足够亮的应用现场，让旧学在无人问津中自行退场；这是以建设代替批判的变革路线
modes.domain_en: Organisational-change and thought-struggle methodology / not eradicating empty learning by critique but displacing it with usefulness: old ideas cannot be killed in polemic; they wither before more effective substitutes — find the new learning enough applications, bright enough, and the old learning vacates the stage unattended; a reform route that builds rather than attacks
modes.definition_zh: 组织变革与思想斗争方法论/朱舜水在日本从未组织对佛教、神道或朱子学末流的公开论战——他的策略是把儒学'做到'：学宫立起来了、释奠行起来了、桥梁造起来了、农政见效了——异邦人不是被说服的，是被'用处'征服的。方法论要点：一、不树敌纲领——批判止于学术辨析，不发动人身与信仰攻击，避免把变革变成教派战争；二、建替代现场——把资源投给'新学能赢的地方'（教育、工程、民生），让成效可见；三、让旧学自然失血——不禁止旧学，只是新的资源、人才与注意力流向看得见效用的地方；四、以质量做广告——一件精品工程胜过十次宣讲。此法在异邦尤其关键：外来者没有论战的本钱，只有作品此法的当代意义在于：变革的胜负手不在论战而在替代品的可见质量——把资源改道给能赢的场景，旧秩序在失血中安静退场。他把这一路线概括为'躬行君子则无间于言动'：与其与僧侣辩儒佛高下，不如把学宫立起来让僧俗都来观礼；与其论辩农政，不如把田亩水利改良到看得见收成。江户思想史上没有留下他与任何教派的骂战记录，却留下了满目的学宫、桥梁与农书——这就是用实去虚的战报。
modes.definition_en: Organisational-change and thought-struggle methodology / in Japan Zhu never organised open polemics against Buddhism, Shinto or the decadent ends of Zhu Xi's school — his strategy was to 'do' Confucianism: the academy stood, the sacrifice was performed, bridges were built, agronomy paid — the foreigners were not persuaded, they were conquered by usefulness. The method: first, no-enemies doctrine — critique stops at scholarly analysis, never personal or faith attack, lest reform become sectarian war; second, build the substitute site — invest resources where the new learning can win (education, works, livelihood), making results visible; third, let the old bleed naturally — do not ban it; let resources, talent and attention flow toward wherever utility is visible; fourth, quality as advertisement — one fine work outweighs ten lectures. The method matters doubly for an outsider: the newcomer has no capital for polemic, only works
modes.source_chapter: 《朱舜水集·杂说》与书札论'躬行胜于辨难'；水户学宫、造桥、农政诸实践
modes.key_quote_zh: 辩赢了又如何——桥立起来、田种好了，道理就不用争了；旧的不必骂倒，新的足够好用，旧的自己会退场。
modes.key_quote_en: What if you win the argument? Once the bridge stands and the fields bear, the principle needs no defending; no need to curse the old down — when the new is useful enough, the old leaves on its own.
key_concepts: 不树敌纲领 the no-enemies doctrine（批判止于学理——防止变革沦为教派战争而失去中间派）
the no-enemies doctrine (critique stays scholarly — preventing reform from degenerating into sectarian war and losing the neutrals)
替代现场 the substitute site（把资源投向新学能赢的可见现场——以建成品替代论战）
the substitute site (invest resources where the new learning visibly wins — built works replacing polemic)
自然失血 natural bleeding（不禁止旧学——只让资源与注意力改道，旧学自行退场）
natural bleeding (do not ban the old — redirect resources and attention, and the old vacates by itself)
作品即广告 the work as advertisement（一件精品胜过十次宣讲——外来者唯一可信的通货是成品）
the work as advertisement (one fine work beats ten lectures — the outsider's only credible currency is the finished artefact)
process_zh: 停止论战预算：明确把'辩赢对方'从目标中移除——把全部资源改配给可建成的项目
选择替代现场：找新学有绝对优势、旧学无法提供的领域（实学、工程、礼制、教育）重点建设
做出标杆成品：集中做出一两件无可辩驳的精品——让'更好'成为可见物而非主张
不阻旧学退路：允许旧学继续存在但不再分配增量资源——定期检视人才与注意力的流向以确认改道生效
process_en: Cancel the polemic budget: explicitly remove 'winning the argument' from goals — reassign all resources to buildable projects
Choose the substitute site: find the domains where the new learning holds absolute advantage and the old offers nothing (pragmatic learning, works, rites, education) and build there
Produce benchmark artefacts: concentrate on one or two impeccable works — making 'better' a visible object rather than a claim
Leave the old an exit: allow the old to persist but allocate it no incremental resources — periodically check the flow of talent and attention to confirm the diversion has taken
representative_cases_zh: 水户学宫的示范效应：学宫建成后成为日本儒学的制度地标——各地藩校仿建，不必朱舜水去任何地方辩论'儒学比佛教好'
造桥与农政的'无言说服'：他设计的桥、改良的农法立见成效——工匠与农民先于士大夫接受了'实学'，因为实学先给了他们好处
对佛教与国学的态度：他终身不改其信念却从不发起攻击——江户思想史上的儒佛之争没有他的战场，但他的学生遍布朝野
representative_cases_en: The demonstrative power of the Mito academy: once built it became the institutional landmark of Confucian learning in Japan — domain schools copied it, and Zhu never had to debate anywhere that 'Confucianism beats Buddhism'

The silent persuasion of bridges and agronomy: his bridge designs and improved farming methods paid off at once — craftsmen and farmers accepted 'substantive learning' before the literati did, because it gave them something first

His stance toward Buddhism and nativist learning: he kept his convictions for life yet launched no attacks — the Edo-period Confucian-Buddhist contest had no battlefield of his, yet his students filled court and country
modern_applications_zh: 技术栈迁移：旧系统不靠'批判大会'退役而靠新系统在关键业务上做出无可辩驳的性能与体验——资源改道，旧系统自然失血
组织方法论变革：新流程先在优势场景做出标杆样板——不禁止旧做法，只不再给旧做法增量资源
社会观念倡导：倡议者以'替代品质量'取胜（更好的产品、更好的服务、更好的叙事）——避免把公共讨论变成立场战争
modern_applications_en: Technology-stack migration: retire the old system not by critique meetings but by the new system's indisputable performance and experience on key workloads — redirect resources and the old bleeds out
Methodological reform in organisations: land the new process as a benchmark exemplar in favourable scenarios — do not ban the old; simply stop feeding it increments
Advocacy in public debate: win by substitute quality (better product, better service, better narrative) — refusing to turn public discourse into a war of camps
representative_figures: 朱舜水（核心）
颜元（平行参照：同样以'习行'替代论辩——但颜元面对的是科举体制内的资源封锁，朱舜水在异邦反而拥有完整的替代现场）
伽利略（对照参照：以论战与审判闻名——朱舜水路线刻意避开论战，两路线的代价结构互为注脚）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Guest-Master Seat
modes.domain_zh: 组织权力与咨询关系方法论/以'宾师'而非'家臣'的身份进入权力结构：受最高礼敬而不入科层、不担执行之责——独立性是影响力的来源，一旦入仕即失去说'不'的位置；以局外之身执局内之教，使建议的分量来自超脱而非隶属
modes.domain_en: Organisational-power and advisory-relationship methodology / entering the power structure as 'guest-master' rather than retainer: receiving the highest honours while staying outside the hierarchy and off the execution line — independence is the source of influence; once in office, the seat to say 'no' is lost; teaching from outside while seated within, the weight of advice derives from detachment rather than subordination
modes.definition_zh: 组织权力与咨询关系方法论/朱舜水与德川光圀的关系是'宾师'制度的范本：光圀执弟子礼、岁给禄米、筑宅供养——但朱舜水不入水户藩官僚序列、不任实际官职、不担行政责任。方法论的算计：一、位差保护——宾师对主君有道义上的教导权，而家臣只有服从义务；独立身份使批评成为'道'的行使而非'逆'的冒犯；二、退出选项——宾师可去而家臣不可走，去留自由本身就是议价能力与清白的保证；三、聚焦杠杆——不入科层使他的时间全部用于最高杠杆的活动（教嗣君、定礼制、审大政方针）而不被日常政务吞噬；四、以德养位——宾师的权威来自学问与人格的持续展示，而非职位的强制。他以此身份影响了水户藩两代人并塑造了水户学此法的当代意义在于：影响力可以不用职权购买——以独立身份、退出自由与持续展示的德学换取说'不'的席位，是咨询与治理的结构设计。此法的当代意义在于：它不否定理论，而是否定不可结算的理论——每一门学问都必须在成品处与账目处接受检验，否则即从知识降格为修辞。此法的当代意义在于：文化转型不是说服工程而是接口工程——先造出一件对方看得见、学得会、用得上的仪式件，其余交给时间与模仿。此法的当代意义在于：一切观测系统先从观测者自己校准起——自我摘除利害与情面，当面回路传递异议，小节零弯曲保大判断零偏差。
modes.definition_en: Organisational-power and advisory-relationship methodology / Zhu's relation with Tokugawa Mitsukuni is the model of the 'guest-master' institution: Mitsukuni performed the disciple's rites, granted stipend and residence — yet Zhu never entered the Mito bureaucratic order, held no actual office, bore no administrative duty. The calculation: first, position-difference protection — a guest-master holds a moral right to instruct his lord, a retainer only the duty to obey; independent status makes criticism an exercise of the Way rather than an offence of insubordination; second, the exit option — the guest-master may leave, the retainer may not; freedom of departure is itself bargaining power and a guarantee of clean hands; third, focus leverage — staying outside the hierarchy devotes all his time to the highest-leverage activities (teaching the heir, fixing the rites, reviewing the great decisions) instead of being devoured by daily administration; fourth, authority fed by virtue — the guest-master's authority rests on the continuous display of learning and character, not positional coercion. From that seat he shaped two generations of Mito and moulded the Mito school
modes.source_chapter: 《朱舜水集》与《安積覚笔录》载宾师礼遇与'不任以官'之实；德川光圀聘礼、禄米、西山山庄诸事
modes.key_quote_zh: 入了他的官册，我就只能听他的了——做宾师：受其礼、教其人、不居其位；我留在体制外面，才站在道义上面。
modes.key_quote_en: Once entered in his registry I could only obey him — so be the guest-master: take his honours, teach his people, keep none of his office; only from outside the structure can one stand upon the Way.
key_concepts: 位差保护 position-difference protection（宾师有教导权而家臣只有服从义务——身份设计决定批评的合法性）
position-difference protection (the guest-master holds a right to instruct, the retainer only a duty to obey — identity design decides the legitimacy of criticism)
退出选项 the exit option（可去可留是议价能力与清白的共同来源——不可走的人说不出不可的话）
the exit option (freedom to leave is the common source of bargaining power and clean hands — one who cannot leave cannot say what must be said)
杠杆聚焦 leverage focus（不入科层把时间留给最高杠杆活动——教继承人、定根本制度）
leverage focus (staying outside the hierarchy reserves time for the highest-leverage work — teaching the heir, fixing foundational institutions)
以德养位 virtue-fed authority（权威持续来自学问与人格的展示——不职而尊的制度化）
virtue-fed authority (authority continuously earned by displayed learning and character — institutionalised honour without office)
process_zh: 谈定名分：入局前把身份、礼遇、边界写成明约（宾师而非属官、不预行政、去留自由）
守住非执行位：始终不进入执行链——建议、评审、教导可以，签字、担责、掌印不行
聚焦高杠杆动作：把精力集中于对继承人与根本制度的影响——拒绝被日常事务分走时间
持续展示德学：以学问、人格与作品维持权威——宾师之位不是一次授予的而是逐日挣得的
process_en: Settle the terms first: before entering, write the status, honours and boundaries into an explicit covenant (guest-master, not officer; no administration; free to leave)
Hold the non-executive seat: never join the execution chain — advise, review, teach, yes; sign, own, seal, no
Focus on high-leverage moves: concentrate on influence over the heir and the foundational institutions — refuse to let routine consume the time
Display virtue and learning continuously: keep authority earned by scholarship, character and works — the guest-master's seat is granted once but earned daily
representative_cases_zh: 光圀的聘礼与礼敬：1672 年光圀在水户西山山庄为朱舜水建别业、命近臣执弟子礼——朱舜水始终未受官职，但藩政大计、世子教育、学宫礼制皆谘而后行
教导世子与重臣：他把精力集中于教导德川光圀及其重臣、世子——宾师之位使他直接影响下一代掌权者而非某一任官僚
辞官不受的长期红利：正因为他始终是'客'，水户藩换代、幕府更迭都未动摇其礼遇——二百五十年后水户学仍尊其为宗师
representative_cases_en: Mitsukuni's engagement and honours: in 1672 Mitsukuni built him a villa at Nishiyama in Mito and had his close men perform the disciple's rites — Zhu never took office, yet grand policy, the heir's education and the rites of the academy all went to him for counsel first

Teaching the heir and the inner circle: he concentrated on instructing Mitsukuni, his leading vassals and the heir — the guest-master's seat gave him direct influence over the next holders of power rather than any single administration

The long dividend of declining office: precisely because he remained a 'guest', changes of generation at Mito and of shogunate at Edo never shook his honours — two hundred fifty years on, the Mito school still honours him as its fountainhead
modern_applications_zh: 董事会与顾问治理：外部专家以'顾问董事/首席科学家'身份进入——给股权与礼遇而不给执行职务，保留说'不'的独立席位
国家级与国际咨询：国际组织专家以'无任所'身份服务多国——不受雇于单一政府以保证公信力
创始人与关键顾问的关系设计：把独立性写进合约（不进入汇报线、可自由离场）——顾问的价值以独立性为前提
modern_applications_en: Board and advisory governance: external experts enter as advisory directors or chief scientists — given equity and honours but no executive post, preserving the independent seat from which to say no
State-level and international advising: experts serve many governments in non-resident capacities — never employed by a single government, to keep credibility
Designing founder–adviser relations: write independence into the contract (outside the reporting line, free to depart) — the adviser's value presupposes independence
representative_figures: 朱舜水（核心）
伊尹（原型参照：'以割烹要汤'说的反面——伊尹以师保之位格影响君王，宾师之制的远古原型）
黄宗羲（对照参照：拒绝仕清而留在故国讲学——朱舜水以异邦宾师实现同样的'不仕而影响'，地理选择不同而结构相同）

modes.domain_zh: 工程学与技艺方法论/以实测、绘图、算料、试制的完整工序把'学问'落到营造：方案先成图、图必合度数、料必可估算、式必先做小样——知识不经过图纸与实物验证就不算掌握；以匠师的工序改造士人的知识生产
modes.domain_en: Engineering and craft methodology / landing 'learning' in construction through the full sequence of measurement, drawing, material estimation and trial fabrication: the scheme first becomes a drawing, the drawing must match the numbers, the materials must be estimable, the form must first be made as a model — knowledge unverified by drawing and artefact does not count as possessed; the craftsman's sequence reforming the scholar's knowledge production
modes.definition_zh: 工程学与技艺方法论/朱舜水不只是讲实学的哲学家，还是动手的工程师与工艺家：《学宫图说》为完整的设计文件——平面、立面、尺寸、料单俱备；他为水户造桥（据传影响日本园林桥梁形制）、指导制作祭器、把中国的建筑、烹饪、园艺、缝纫技艺系统传给日本工匠。方法论要点：一、图先行——任何营造先出可复核的图纸（含尺寸与材料），拒绝'大概齐'的口头工程；二、数先行——尺寸、角度、料量必须算定，图纸即承诺；三、样先行——复杂结构先做缩尺或局部试制，验证后再放大；四、技艺成文——把隐性技艺写成图式与口诀使其可传授。实测营造是'实理实学'在物上的完成：一个理是否实，造得出来才算数此法的当代意义在于：知识只有经过图纸、算料与小样的完整工序才算真正掌握——图纸即承诺，样品即检验，规程即传承。此法的当代意义在于：流亡与迁移不只是逃难——按安、敬、空三准主动选址，把不可挽回的损失转化为文明与知识的异地备份。此法的当代意义在于：把失败与亡国写成可归因的账本而非诉状——账本配恒定价值标尺双轨校验，可教、可传、可在人身上接续。
modes.definition_en: Engineering and craft methodology / Zhu was not only a philosopher of pragmatic learning but a working engineer and craftsman: his 'Illustrations of the Academy' is a complete design document — plans, elevations, dimensions and bills of materials; he built bridges at Mito (said to have shaped Japanese garden-bridge forms), guided the making of ritual vessels, and systematically transmitted Chinese building, cuisine, horticulture and tailoring to Japanese craftsmen. The method: first, drawing first — no construction without a checkable drawing (dimensions and materials included); verbal engineering of 'roughly right' is refused; second, numbers first — dimensions, angles and quantities must be computed; a drawing is a commitment; third, model first — complex structures are first made at reduced scale or in part, verified, then scaled up; fourth, craft written down — tacit skill is recorded as diagrams and mnemonics so it can be taught. Measured building is 'substantive learning' completed in matter: whether a principle is real is settled only when it can be built
modes.source_chapter: 《朱舜水集·学宫图说》（图式、尺寸、料单俱全）；水户造桥、祭器制作与诸工艺传授事
modes.key_quote_zh: 嘴上说得圆不如纸上画得准、手上造得出——图要合度、料要可算、式要先试；造不出来的道理，不是道理。
modes.key_quote_en: A round tongue is worth less than an accurate drawing and a buildable hand — the drawing must match measure, the materials be computable, the form first trialled; a principle that cannot be built is no principle.
key_concepts: 图先行 drawing first（可复核图纸是工程的起点——尺寸与材料写进图纸即写进责任）
drawing first (the checkable drawing is the start of the work — dimensions and materials in the drawing are commitments)
数先行 numbers first（角度尺寸料量必先算定——图纸即契约）
numbers first (angles, dimensions, quantities computed beforehand — the drawing as contract)
样先行 model first（复杂结构先做小样验证——放大前的实物检验）
model first (complex structures trialled at small scale first — physical verification before scaling)
技艺成文 craft written down（隐性手艺转化为图式与口诀——可传授性是技艺的完成态）
craft written down (tacit skill turned into diagrams and mnemonics — teachability as the finished state of craft)
process_zh: 需求与场地实测：先量场地、定功能——拒绝跳过勘察直接画图
出图与算料：绘制含全部尺寸的图纸并列材料清单——图纸交由第三方可复核
小样试制：关键构件先做缩尺样或局部样——验证结构与工艺后再整体施工
传授与归档：施工中同步记录工艺要点成图式口诀——建成后图纸与记录归档，成为可复用的资产
process_en: Survey need and site: measure the ground, fix the functions — never draw before surveying
Draw and estimate: produce a drawing with all dimensions and a bill of materials — a third party must be able to check it
Trial the model: make reduced or partial samples of critical members — verify structure and craft before full construction
Transmit and archive: record craft points as diagrams and mnemonics during the work — after completion, archive drawings and records as reusable assets
representative_cases_zh: 《学宫图说》的工程深度：书中为学宫庙制绘出总平面与单体图式并注明尺寸做法——日本以此建成的圣堂成为可复制的工程模板
水户造桥：他设计的石桥（小石川后乐园桥等传为其设计）比例合度、至今犹存——设计经受三百年的荷载与风雨检验
祭器与工艺传授：他绘图指导制作祭器并传烹饪、园艺、裁缝之法——把'士'的礼制转译为'匠'可执行的工艺
representative_cases_en: The engineering depth of the 'Illustrations of the Academy': general plans and unit diagrams with dimensions and methods — the halls built from them became a replicable engineering template in Japan
Bridges at Mito: bridges said to be his design (as at Koishikawa Kōraku-en) are proportioned and still standing — a design tested by three centuries of load and weather

Ritual vessels and craft transmission: he drew and guided the making of vessels and taught cuisine, horticulture and tailoring — translating the rites of the 'scholar' into craft executable by the 'artisan'
modern_applications_zh: 软件与硬件工程：设计文档先行（含接口与尺寸级细节）、关键路径先做原型验证——拒绝口头架构
制造业出海与技术转移：把隐性工艺写成图文规程再交本地团队——'技艺成文'是技术转移成败的分水岭
建筑与规划项目：场地实测+料单透明+小样验证三步作为乙方交付底线
modern_applications_en: Software and hardware engineering: design documents first (interfaces and dimension-level detail), prototypes on the critical path — verbal architecture refused
Manufacturing abroad and technology transfer: write tacit processes into illustrated procedures before handing to local teams — 'craft written down' is the watershed of transfer success
Building and planning projects: site survey plus transparent bills of materials plus model verification as the contractor's delivery floor
representative_figures: 朱舜水（核心）
李诫（先例参照：《营造法式》以图样与料例规范营造——同一'实测+成文'传统的宋代高峰）
达·芬奇（跨文明平行：以工程图与试制打通艺术与工程——但达·芬奇多图少成，朱舜水图成物就）

modes.name_en: The Method of Keeping the Lineage in Dress
modes.domain_zh: 符号政治与文化存续方法论/政权可以更替而'统'寄于符号：衣冠、礼器、发式、葬制是最小而最不可让渡的存续载体——守住符号不等于幻想复国，而是为未来的'再接续'保存物理接口；以日常穿着执行历史记忆
modes.domain_en: Symbolic-politics and cultural-survival methodology / the regime may change while the 'lineage' lodges in symbols: dress, ritual vessels, hairstyle and burial are the smallest and least surrenderable carriers of survival — holding the symbols is not fantasising restoration but preserving a physical interface for future reconnection; executing historical memory through daily wearing
modes.definition_zh: 符号政治与文化存续方法论/朱舜水留日二十年终身明式衣冠，文章署'明孤臣'，自题墓碑'明征君'——这些不是怀旧的姿态而是一套符号策略：清廷以剃发易服为征服的身体印记，朱舜水以不剃不易为存统的身体印记；同一身体成为两个政权争夺的文本，而他坚持由自己书写。方法论要点：一、选最小可守符号——衣冠可日日穿着、难以剥夺，比空喊口号更持久；二、日常化执行——符号必须进入每日生活（穿着、署名、居所规制）而非仅存于宣言；三、符号与传承绑定——衣冠之下必配衣冠所承载之学（礼、史、经），否则符号只剩空洞；四、预留再接续接口——把图式、仪注、族谱、师承写成可被后人取用的档案。符号存统与殖民同化是同一场争夺的两端此法的当代意义在于：在被迫同化的环境里，选最小、可日常执行、与真知识绑定的符号坚持下去——符号不空壳，统绪即可接续。他署'明孤臣'、纪明正朔、题'明征君'墓——三个动作分别覆盖了生前署名、文中纪年与身后题铭，构成一条从生到死无断点的符号链；而支撑这条链的是释奠仪注、学宫图式与经史讲授：符号之下有可传之学，故日本后人能行其礼、续其学，符号因此从未空壳化。
modes.definition_en: Symbolic-politics and cultural-survival methodology / for twenty years in Japan Zhu wore Ming dress to the end, signed 'the lone subject of Ming', epitaphed himself 'Ming Zhengjun' — not nostalgia but a symbolic strategy: the Qing had stamped conquest on the body through shaving and dress; Zhu stamped survival on the same body through refusal; the same body became a text contested by two regimes, and he insisted on writing it himself. The method: first, choose the smallest defensible symbol — dress is worn daily and hard to strip away, more durable than any shouted slogan; second, execute daily — the symbol must enter everyday life (what is worn, how one signs, the regulation of one's dwelling), not only declarations; third, bind symbol to transmission — beneath the dress must lie the learning the dress carries (rites, history, classics), else the symbol goes hollow; fourth, leave an interface for reconnection — diagrams, rubrics, genealogies and lineage written into archives later generations can draw on. Symbolic survival and colonial assimilation are two ends of one contest
modes.source_chapter: 《朱舜水集》署名与书札（'明孤臣'自称）；《安積覚笔录》载其衣冠之守；殁后葬瑞龙山、碑题'明征君朱之瑜墓'
modes.key_quote_zh: 他们拿剃刀征服身体，我就用衣冠签回主权——天天穿着，就是天天在位；符号若不配着学问，就只是一件旧衣裳。
modes.key_quote_en: They conquered the body with the razor; I sign the sovereignty back with the dress — worn every day, it reigns every day; a symbol without its learning is only an old garment.
key_concepts: 最小可守符号 the smallest defensible symbol（选择可日常执行、难以剥夺、代价可承受的符号载体）
the smallest defensible symbol (choose a carrier wearable daily, hard to strip, bearable in cost)
日常化执行 daily execution（符号进入每日生活的最小动作——穿着、署名、规制）
daily execution (the symbol enters the smallest acts of daily life — dress, signature, regulation)
符号-学问绑定 symbol-learning binding（符号必须承载可传授之学——防止符号空壳化）
symbol-learning binding (the symbol must carry teachable learning — guarding against the empty shell of symbolism)
再接续接口 the reconnection interface（图式、仪注、师承写成档案——为未来保存物理接口）
the reconnection interface (diagrams, rubrics and lineage archived — a physical interface preserved for the future)
process_zh: 盘点符号资产：列出仍可合法持有的符号（服饰、文字、礼制、姓名题署）并评估各自的维持成本
选择执行集：确定一小组可日日执行的符号动作——宁少而恒，不多而辍
绑定传习内容：让每个符号都附带对应学问的传授义务——使符号保持有意义的重量
建档备续：把图式、仪注、师承与自身定位写成档案——假设有一天'统'要再接续，接口随时可用
process_en: Inventory symbolic assets: list the symbols still lawfully holdable (dress, script, rites, signatures) and cost out the keeping of each
Fix the execution set: settle on a small set of daily symbol-actions — rather few and constant than many and broken
Bind transmission: attach to each symbol the duty of teaching its corresponding learning — keeping the symbol meaningfully heavy
Archive for reconnection: write the diagrams, rubrics, lineage and one's own position into archives — so that should the lineage ever be reconnected, the interface is ready
representative_cases_zh: 二十年不易服：他在日本始终明服蓄发（未剃发）——这件日常小事成为两百多年后中日史家反复书写的政治文本
署名与题铭系统：'明孤臣'署名、'明征君'碑题、著作以明朝纪年——一套贯通署名、葬制、纪年的符号档案
祭器与仪注的保存：他把释奠图式、祭器形制留于水户——符号背后是可操作的知识，故德川后世仍能行其礼
representative_cases_en: Twenty years unchanged dress: in Japan he wore Ming dress and kept his hair unshaved to the end — a small daily matter that became a political text historians in both countries still write about two centuries later

The signature and inscription system: 'lone subject of Ming' in signature, 'Ming Zhengjun' on the stele, Ming reign-dates in his writings — one symbolic archive spanning signature, burial and chronology
Preserved vessels and rubrics: he left the Shidian diagrams and vessel forms at Mito — behind the symbols lies operable knowledge, so the Tokugawa descendants could still perform his rites
modern_applications_zh: 组织并购后的文化存续：被收购方保留最小可守的文化符号（名称、仪式、纪念日）并与核心知识绑定——防止文化空壳化
离散社群的身份维护：以日常可执行的文化实践（语言、饮食、节庆）+档案化（教学材料、族谱）维护身份——符号必须有内容
品牌与老字号治理：老字号的核心资产是'符号-工艺'绑定体——只留招牌不传工艺即是符号空壳
modern_applications_en: Cultural survival after acquisition: the acquired side keeps a minimal defensible set of symbols (name, rites, anniversaries) bound to core knowledge — guarding against a hollowed culture
Identity maintenance of diasporas: daily-executable cultural practice (language, food, festivals) plus archiving (teaching materials, genealogies) — symbols must carry content
Brand and heritage governance: a heritage brand's core asset is the symbol–craft binding — a shop sign without transmitted craft is an empty shell
representative_figures: 朱舜水（核心）
郑思肖（先例参照：宋遗民画兰不画土、以符号守统——朱舜水把这一传统做成长期工程）
甘地（跨文明平行：以服饰（土布）作为政治符号的日常化执行——同样'身体即声明'）

modes.name_en: The Method of Casting History from Classics and Annals
modes.domain_zh: 史学方法论与历史教育方法论/以经史互铸来对抗亡国后的失史：经提供价值框架、史提供事实账本——两者互相校验，任何单边都易腐；把历史写成'账'（兴亡之由、制度之失、人物之责）而非'诉'（悲情叙事），使亡国的历史成为可继承的方法论资产
modes.domain_en: Historiographical-methodology and history-education methodology / casting classics and annals against each other to resist the loss of history after national ruin: the classics supply the frame of value, the annals the ledger of fact — each audits the other, for either alone corrupts; history is written as a 'ledger' (causes of rise and fall, failures of institutions, responsibilities of men) rather than a 'lament' (melodrama of grievance), making the history of a fallen state an inheritable asset of method
modes.definition_zh: 史学方法论与历史教育方法论/朱舜水晚年在水户主持史事讲授并参与《大日本史》编纂方略的讨论氛围——他教弟子的不是背诵经文而是'以史为账'：每个王朝的兴亡都要算出可归因的账目（制度、用人、风俗、边防）；每条账目又须以经典的价值标尺复核（仁、义、礼、法是否仍在）。方法论要点：一、经史双轨——经给'应当'，史给'曾经'，互为校验防止单边腐化（经腐成教条，史腐成考据）；二、归因记账——兴亡必有账目，账目必有条目，条目必有可讨论的证据；三、拒悲情化——亡国之史最易写成诉状，诉状不能传灯，账本才能；四、教学即铸史——把史学做成课程与问答（安積覚等弟子的笔录即是活的史册），使史学在人身上延续。《大日本史》的'大义名分'史学即此传统的日本结晶此法的当代意义在于：把失败与亡国写成可归因的账本而非诉状——账本配恒定价值标尺双轨校验，可教、可传、可在人身上接续。此法的当代意义在于：把不可执行的忠诚誓言翻译为可执行、可核验、愿付代价的底线清单——底线存则立场存，且比任何宣言更难被伪造。
modes.definition_en: Historiographical-methodology and history-education methodology / casting classics and annals against each other to resist the loss of history after national ruin: in his late years at Mito he lectured on history and fed the deliberative soil of the Dai Nihonshi — he taught disciples not to memorise the classics but to 'keep accounts with history': every dynasty's rise and fall must yield attributable entries (institutions, appointments, customs, defence), and every entry must be audited against the value-scale of the classics (whether humaneness, duty, rite and law still held). The method: first, twin tracks of classic and annal — the classics give the 'ought', the annals the 'was', auditing each other against single-track decay (classics rot into dogma, annals into antiquarianism); second, attribution as bookkeeping — every rise and fall has entries, entries have items, items have discussable evidence; third, refuse the lament — the history of a fallen state is easily written as an indictment; an indictment cannot transmit the lamp, a ledger can; fourth, teaching as casting — history made into courses and question-answers (the notebooks of Asaka Tanpaku and others are living annals), so historiography survives in persons. The 'great-duty' historiography of the Dai Nihonshi is this tradition crystallised in Japan
modes.source_chapter: 《朱舜水集·答问》论读史与兴亡归因；《安積覚笔录》；《大日本史》编纂思潮与水户学之渊源
modes.key_quote_zh: 诉状留不住国史——把亡国写成账本：哪一条制度错了、哪一个人失了责、哪一种风俗坏了几世；账本可以教，教了就能接续。
modes.key_quote_en: An indictment cannot keep a national history — write the fall as a ledger: which institution failed, which man defaulted, which custom rotted for how many generations; a ledger can be taught, and what is taught can be continued.
key_concepts: 经史双轨审计 the classic-annal twin audit（经给'应当'、史给'曾经'——互相校验防止单边腐化）
the classic-annal twin audit (the classics give the 'ought', the annals the 'was' — mutual auditing against single-track decay)
兴亡记账 rise-and-fall bookkeeping（每个兴亡都可拆为可归因条目与可讨论证据）
rise-and-fall bookkeeping (every rise and fall decomposable into attributable entries with discussable evidence)
拒悲情化 anti-lament（把亡国史从诉状改写为账本——诉状消耗情绪，账本生产方法）
anti-lament (rewriting a fallen state's history from indictment to ledger — indictments consume emotion, ledgers produce method)
教学即铸史 teaching as casting（史学以课程、问答与笔录在人身上延续——人是最可靠的史册介质）
teaching as casting (historiography continued in persons through courses, Q&A and notebooks — people as the most durable medium of annals)
process_zh: 建立价值标尺：先立经之'应当'（仁义礼法的可操作定义）——作为审计兴亡的恒定标尺
逐代记账：对每个王朝兴亡列出归因条目（制度、用人、风俗、边防）并配证据——不许以'天命'一笔带过
双轨校验：以史实复核经义是否空悬、以经义复核史评是否失准——双向修正后定稿
转为课程与问答：把账本改写为可教的课程与问答体——以弟子笔录形成活的续史机制
process_en: Fix the value scale: first establish the classics' 'ought' (operable definitions of humaneness, duty, rite, law) as the constant scale for auditing rise and fall
Keep the ledger reign by reign: list attributable entries (institutions, appointments, customs, defence) with evidence for every dynasty — 'heaven's mandate' is not accepted as a line item
Twin-track audit: use fact to test whether the ought has gone hollow, and the ought to test whether the judgment has gone astray — revise both ways before closing the entry
Convert to courses and questions: rewrite the ledger as teachable lessons in Q&A form — disciples' notebooks forming a living mechanism of continued history
representative_cases_zh: 在水户的讲授与笔录：他以问答体教安積覚、今井弘济等——弟子笔录（《安積覚笔录》《舜水先生行实》）成为其学与史的活载体
对明亡的记账式总结：他论明亡不诉'天命'而列制度、用人、风俗之账——'虚学误国''武备废弛''纪纲坏于朋党'皆可指认
《大日本史》的方法论血缘：水户学编《大日本史》以'大义名分'评断南北朝正统——价值标尺+史实记账的经史互铸在日本结出正史
representative_cases_en: Lecturing at Mito and the notebooks: he taught Asaka Tanpaku, Imai Kōsai and others in question-and-answer form — their notebooks (the Asaka Tanpaku hiroku, the Shusui sensai jitsuroku) became the living carriers of his learning and history

A ledger-style audit of the Ming's fall: he attributed the fall not to 'heaven's mandate' but to entries — 'empty learning ruined the state', 'military preparedness decayed', 'discipline broken by faction' — all pointable

The methodological lineage of the Dai Nihonshi: the Mito school judged the legitimacy of the Northern and Southern Courts by 'great duty and correct standing' — the classic-annal casting of value-scale and factual ledger bearing its official history in Japan
modern_applications_zh: 企业史与复盘治理：把失败项目写成归因账本（制度、用人、流程、市场）而非检讨报告——账本可教，报告会烂
公共历史教育：历史课程以'价值标尺+证据账本'双轨设计——防止历史教育沦为记忆政治或考据碎片
机构知识传承：核心方法论以'问答笔录'形式在人身上传续——文档会过期，师承不会
modern_applications_en: Corporate history and retrospective governance: write failed projects as attribution ledgers (institutions, people, process, market) rather than review reports — ledgers can be taught; reports rot
Public history education: design history curricula on twin tracks of value-scale plus evidence ledger — keeping history education from collapsing into memory politics or antiquarian fragments
Institutional knowledge transmission: continue core methodology through Q&A notebooks carried by persons — documents expire, lineage does not
